text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how today's gonna go. It's a long distance after all,
so maybe Mayano Top Gun? She's supposed to be a genius, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, but I really want
Fuji Kiseki to do her best too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The entire grandstand swelled with anticipation for the battle about to begin. Amidst it all, in the paddock—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't my nemesis, Mayano Top Gun.
As innocent and free-spirited as ever, I see.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm?
Fuji-senpai, do you understand your position here?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Long distance is Maya's specialty! Fuji-senpai might be so shocked she won't know which way is up! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't go saying you never want to run again
once this is all over, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, quite the talker, aren't you!
Though you might want to watch your tongue.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Same to you,
if you don't want today to turn into a trauma, that is.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on, wasn't Fuji-sama just
super cool right now?! Was she always
the type to say things like that?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Mayano-chan is being bolder than usual,
which makes her even cuter!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan
text_block_list.text:
Right! I hope they both do their best~!
—Wait, why were they arguing in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just kidding.
Thanks for the help, Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we managed to add
a little extra spice to hype up the race.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, no problem at all♪
I kinda meant it for real, anyway!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Quite the bold declaration of war.
—Please go easy on me.
